chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Next element which we are going to learn in HTML is our heading elements.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: If I have to create different headings on my page, then we already have tags for that.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: We have six different heading tags in HTML.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: We take them from h1 to h6.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: One tag is my h1 which displays the biggest heading.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Whatever you write in it, if I write it in AVCD, then it will display in the largest size in the heading terms.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: The second tag is my h2, the third tag is h3, the fourth tag is my h4, the fifth is my h5, and the sixth tag is my h6.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: And these are the size which goes down.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: If you want to give the smallest heading, then it will come in h6 and the biggest heading will come in h1.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: So these six different levels represent section headings.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: How can we see the example of how the heading represents?

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: If I go to my browser and accept that I have opened a page called Avengers Wikipedia.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: I have opened this page.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Now in this page, the title of the title is my biggest heading.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Now what will be the smallest heading?

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: This is my biggest heading.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: My one level small heading will be the plot.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: This will be the cast on the same level.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: So if I have to write in h1 heading, then I will write my main title.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: After that, the biggest heading, the plot or the cast, I will write it in h2.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Now if I have to give another subheading in h2, then I will write it in h3.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: And in this way, we create different levels of heading.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: For example, if I talk about my HTML file, then I can write h1 here.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: This is my opening tag, this is my closing tag.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Now in this, I can write my main heading.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: This is my main heading.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Let's assume that my main heading is Avengers.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: So in this way, I have displayed my main heading.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Now if I have to display their small subheadings, then I will display all the subheadings in h2.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: For example, I can write my Avengers name here, I can write the name of Iron Man.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: If you don't know about Avengers, then this is a random name that I am writing.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Here I can write Thor.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: In the next line, I can write Hulk.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: So in this way, if I talk about my web browser, then the main heading on my page is a big display.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Because I wrote it in h1.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: And the headings that are written in h2 are smaller than the headings in h1.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: So in h1, we will write our main heading and smaller than that in h2.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: In the same way, if I want to write in h3, then if I display anything here, then it will be displayed in a smaller font.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: So this is my smaller heading.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Now h1, h2, h3, all these headings are their default size.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: The headings of h1 will always be printed in the same default size.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: The headings of h2 will always be shown on the page in the same default size.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: The headings of h3 will also be shown on the same default size on the page.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Similarly, for 6 headings, 6 default sizes are already defined.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: And usually when we are writing CSS, i.e. when we are defining the style of our web page,

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: then we can change the font for the rest of the text.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: But usually, the headings of h1, h2, h3, we don't change their font size for headings.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Because when the font size is already defined by default, then we don't play with the html by default rules that much.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: So in maximum cases, we are not changing the default size of the headings, which is their default size.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: We keep it the same.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: And if we want to write our html program well, then in the html code, in the file, usually we have only one h1 tag.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: It is not like we will display multiple h1 tags.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: So h1 tag is only one, we can keep our h2 tags multiple depending upon what level we are talking about on our page.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Now if I want, then here, I have written heading tags, I can mix my paragraph tag with them.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: This is a paragraph.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: In this way, I can write a paragraph tag after each heading.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Let's do this save and refresh it.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: So here, my main heading is here.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: This is the help of h1.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: After that, this line should be displayed with the help of my h2.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: So this is displayed with the help of h2, then a paragraph.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Then a heading to, then a paragraph.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Then a heading to, then a paragraph.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: So I can see that the text size of the paragraph is small and headings are usually the text size of the paragraph.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Headings are usually bigger than the text size of the paragraph.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: If I write h2 instead of h6, which is my smallest heading, then save and run.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: All the headings are not bigger than the paragraph size, but mostly the headings we are using in practical life are bigger than our paragraph.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Because the paragraph is usually used to display its related content and normal text.

chunks.title: Heading Elements
chunks.text: Whereas the main title of the headings is used to display the main things.
